+  # The real customer workflow in a real browser (M2C): sign in through Keycloak, a simulated call
+  # becomes a PostgreSQL task, the already-open Heute shows it by itself, Erledigt completes it,
+  # and it stays completed across reload and replay. Everything runs for real except the call: a
+  # fresh PostgreSQL test database as the NOBYPASSRLS application role, the compiled API, the
+  # standalone owner app and the Keycloak realm from the compose file. Separate from `e2e` (the
+  # smoke and accessibility suite, which needs none of these services). Mandatory: it is in the
+  # `verify` job's needs, and a missing, skipped or failing acceptance test fails it.
+  e2e-slice:
+    name: full-stack browser acceptance (postgres, keycloak)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    services:
+      # Real PostgreSQL, matching the local stack. An embedded substitute runs as superuser and
+      # silently bypasses row-level security, so isolation tests against one would pass while
+      # proving nothing (INV-01).
+      postgres:
+        image: pgvector/pgvector@sha256:cf134a767f474095eeba57e0117be8e568e011a63f33fbf252f14c9b760f8e6f
+        env:
+          POSTGRES_USER: moin_owner
+          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-only-not-a-secret
+          POSTGRES_DB: moin
+          POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C'
+        ports: ['5432:5432']
+        options: >-
+          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U moin_owner -d moin"
+          --health-interval 2s
+          --health-timeout 5s
+          --health-retries 30
+    env:
+      TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL: postgres://moin_owner:ci-only-not-a-secret@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
+      TEST_DATABASE_MIGRATOR_URL: postgres://moin_migrator:ci-only-not-a-secret@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
+      TEST_DATABASE_APP_URL: postgres://moin_app:ci-only-not-a-secret@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
+      TEST_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_URL: postgres://moin_provisioner:ci-only-not-a-secret@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
+      TEST_DATABASE_IDENTITY_URL: postgres://moin_identity:ci-only-not-a-secret@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres
+      TEST_OIDC_ISSUER_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/realms/moin-local

+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          node-version-file: .nvmrc
+          cache: pnpm
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
+
+      # Both builds first, so a compile error fails in seconds, before any service starts. The API
+      # runs from `dist` (Node cannot run the server's decorators from source). The web build
+      # compiles in the loopback `/api/*` proxy the browser needs when the two run as separate
+      # local processes; the build refuses any non-loopback origin.
+      - run: pnpm --filter @moin/server build
+      - run: pnpm --filter @moin/web build
+        env:
+          OWNER_API_PROXY_ORIGIN: http://127.0.0.1:3101
+
+      # The service container runs no init scripts, so the roles the local stack creates are
+      # created here instead. The application role is NOBYPASSRLS exactly as in production.
+      - name: Create database roles
+        env:
+          PGPASSWORD: ci-only-not-a-secret
+        run: |
+          psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U moin_owner -d moin -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
+          CREATE ROLE moin_app WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_migrator WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_readonly WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_provisioner WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_dispatcher WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_support_ro WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_reporting WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          CREATE ROLE moin_identity WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'ci-only-not-a-secret' NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOSUPERUSER;
+          GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE moin TO moin_app, moin_migrator, moin_readonly,
+            moin_provisioner, moin_dispatcher, moin_support_ro, moin_reporting, moin_identity;
+          GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE moin TO moin_migrator;
+          REVOKE TEMPORARY ON DATABASE moin FROM PUBLIC;
+          GRANT TEMPORARY ON DATABASE moin TO moin_app, moin_migrator, moin_readonly,
+            moin_provisioner, moin_dispatcher, moin_support_ro, moin_reporting;
+          REVOKE CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE postgres FROM PUBLIC;
+          GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE postgres TO moin_app, moin_migrator, moin_readonly,
+            moin_provisioner, moin_dispatcher, moin_support_ro, moin_reporting;
+          REVOKE CONNECT ON DATABASE template1 FROM PUBLIC;
+          REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION lo_create(oid), lo_creat(integer), lo_from_bytea(oid, bytea) FROM PUBLIC;
+          SQL
+
+      - name: Start the local OIDC provider
+        run: docker compose up -d --wait oidc
+
+      - name: Browser acceptance
+        run: pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.slice.config.ts
+
+      # Runs even when the tests failed or were skipped: the job fails unless the report shows
+      # every required test ran and passed.
+      - name: Check the acceptance report
+        if: always()
+        # `bash` with pipefail: the checker's exit code must survive the pipe into `tee`.
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          touch test-results/live-today-timings.jsonl
+          node scripts/check-slice-report.ts test-results/slice-report.json test-results/live-today-timings.jsonl | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+
+      - name: Service diagnostics
+        if: failure()
+        run: |
+          docker compose logs --no-color --tail 200 oidc || true
+          tail -n 200 test-results/e2e-slice-processes.log || true
+
+      # Reports, timings and process logs carry only synthetic fixtures (INV-16) and no caller

+      - if: always()

+      - if: failure()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          name: e2e-slice-traces
+          path: test-results/**/*.zip
+          retention-days: 7

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { REQUIRED_TITLES, problems, type PlaywrightReport } from './check-slice-report.ts';
+
+function report(
+  titles: readonly string[],
+  overrides: Partial<PlaywrightReport['stats']> = {},
+  failing: readonly string[] = [],
+): PlaywrightReport {
+  return {
+    stats: { expected: titles.length, unexpected: 0, flaky: 0, skipped: 0, ...overrides },
+    suites: [
+      { suites: [{ specs: titles.map((title) => ({ title, ok: !failing.includes(title) })) }] },

+/**
+ * Vertical-slice browser report check (M2C).
+ *
+ * The full-stack browser job must not pass by running nothing. Playwright exits 0 when every
+ * test that ran passed, and a skipped test, a renamed test or a deleted file would still leave a
+ * green job. This reads the JSON report of that run and fails unless every required acceptance
+ * test ran and passed, with nothing skipped, flaky or unexpected.
+ *
+ *   node scripts/check-slice-report.ts <playwright-report.json> [live-today-timings.jsonl]
+ *
+ * Prints a Markdown summary (for the job summary) on stdout; problems go to stderr.
+ */
+
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+
+/**
+ * Each entry is a phrase one required acceptance test's title contains: every test of the suite.
+ * Adding a test to the suite means adding its phrase here, so none can vanish unnoticed.
+ */
+export const REQUIRED_TITLES: readonly string[] = [
+  'a stale view gets a truthful conflict message',
+  'a response lost after the commit is reconciled',
+  'a lost response that cannot be read back',
+  'a request that never reached the server',
+  'reaches the owner on Heute and stays there',
+  'completes a callback with Erledigt and it stays completed',
+  'appears by itself, once, without a reload',
+  'reaches another open session',
+  'an outage leaves the list as it is',
+  'a revoked session shows the signed-out page',
+];
+
+interface Spec {
+  title: string;
+  ok: boolean;
+}
+
+interface Suite {
+  specs?: Spec[];
+  suites?: Suite[];
+}
+
+export interface PlaywrightReport {
+  stats: { expected: number; unexpected: number; flaky: number; skipped: number };
+  suites: Suite[];
+}
+
+function specsOf(suites: readonly Suite[]): Spec[] {
+  return suites.flatMap((suite) => [...(suite.specs ?? []), ...specsOf(suite.suites ?? [])]);
+}
+
+/** What is wrong with a report; empty when the acceptance run is whole and green. */
+export function problems(report: PlaywrightReport): string[] {
+  const found: string[] = [];
+  const { expected, unexpected, flaky, skipped } = report.stats;
+  if (unexpected > 0) found.push(`${String(unexpected)} test(s) failed`);
+  if (flaky > 0) found.push(`${String(flaky)} test(s) were flaky (retries are off)`);
+  if (skipped > 0) found.push(`${String(skipped)} test(s) were skipped`);
+  const specs = specsOf(report.suites);
+  if (expected < REQUIRED_TITLES.length) {
+    found.push(
+      `only ${String(expected)} passing test(s), at least ${String(REQUIRED_TITLES.length)} required`,
+    );
+  }
+  for (const phrase of REQUIRED_TITLES) {
+    const match = specs.find((spec) => spec.title.includes(phrase));
+    if (match === undefined) found.push(`required test missing: "${phrase}"`);
+    else if (!match.ok) found.push(`required test did not pass: "${match.title}"`);
+  }
+  return found;
+}
+
+function summary(report: PlaywrightReport, timings: string): string {
+  const rows = specsOf(report.suites).map(
+    (spec) => `| ${spec.ok ? 'pass' : 'FAIL'} | ${spec.title} |`,
+  );
+  return [
+    '### Full-stack browser acceptance',
+    '',
+    `${String(report.stats.expected)} passed, ${String(report.stats.unexpected)} failed, ${String(report.stats.skipped)} skipped.`,
+    '',
+    '| Result | Test |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...rows,
+    '',
+    '#### Commit-to-render timings (task row `created_at` to visible card)',
+    '',
+    '```',
+    timings.trim(),
+    '```',
+  ].join('\n');
+}
+
+function main(): number {
+  const [reportPath, timingsPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
+  if (reportPath === undefined) {
+    console.error('usage: check-slice-report.ts <playwright-report.json> [timings.jsonl]');
+    return 2;
+  }
+  const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(reportPath, 'utf8')) as PlaywrightReport;
+  const timings = timingsPath === undefined ? '' : readFileSync(timingsPath, 'utf8');
+  console.log(summary(report, timings));
+  const found = problems(report);
+  for (const line of found) console.error(`slice report: ${line}`);
+  return found.length === 0 ? 0 : 1;
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1]?.endsWith('check-slice-report.ts') === true) process.exitCode = main();

+/**
+ * Vertical-slice browser report check (M2C).
+ *
+ * The full-stack browser job must not pass by running nothing. Playwright exits 0 when every
+ * test that ran passed, and a skipped test, a renamed test or a deleted file would still leave a
+ * green job. This reads the JSON report of that run and fails unless every required acceptance
+ * test ran and passed, with nothing skipped, flaky or unexpected.
+ *
+ *   node scripts/check-slice-report.ts <playwright-report.json> [live-today-timings.jsonl]
+ *
+ * Prints a Markdown summary (for the job summary) on stdout; problems go to stderr.
+ */
+
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+
+/**
+ * Each entry is a phrase one required acceptance test's title contains: every test of the suite.
+ * Adding a test to the suite means adding its phrase here, so none can vanish unnoticed.
+ */
+export const REQUIRED_TITLES: readonly string[] = [
+  'a stale view gets a truthful conflict message',
+  'a response lost after the commit is reconciled',
+  'a lost response that cannot be read back',
+  'a request that never reached the server',
+  'reaches the owner on Heute and stays there',
+  'completes a callback with Erledigt and it stays completed',
+  'appears by itself, once, without a reload',
+  'reaches another open session',
+  'an outage leaves the list as it is',
+  'a revoked session shows the signed-out page',
+];
+
+interface Spec {
+  title: string;
+  ok: boolean;
+}
+
+interface Suite {
+  specs?: Spec[];
+  suites?: Suite[];
+}
+
+export interface PlaywrightReport {
+  stats: { expected: number; unexpected: number; flaky: number; skipped: number };
+  suites: Suite[];
+}
+
+function specsOf(suites: readonly Suite[]): Spec[] {
+  return suites.flatMap((suite) => [...(suite.specs ?? []), ...specsOf(suite.suites ?? [])]);
+}
+
+/** What is wrong with a report; empty when the acceptance run is whole and green. */
+export function problems(report: PlaywrightReport): string[] {
+  const found: string[] = [];
+  const { expected, unexpected, flaky, skipped } = report.stats;
+  if (unexpected > 0) found.push(`${String(unexpected)} test(s) failed`);
+  if (flaky > 0) found.push(`${String(flaky)} test(s) were flaky (retries are off)`);
+  if (skipped > 0) found.push(`${String(skipped)} test(s) were skipped`);
+  const specs = specsOf(report.suites);
+  if (expected < REQUIRED_TITLES.length) {
+    found.push(
+      `only ${String(expected)} passing test(s), at least ${String(REQUIRED_TITLES.length)} required`,
+    );
+  }
+  for (const phrase of REQUIRED_TITLES) {
+    const match = specs.find((spec) => spec.title.includes(phrase));
+    if (match === undefined) found.push(`required test missing: "${phrase}"`);
+    else if (!match.ok) found.push(`required test did not pass: "${match.title}"`);
+  }
+  return found;
+}
+
+function summary(report: PlaywrightReport, timings: string): string {
+  const rows = specsOf(report.suites).map(
+    (spec) => `| ${spec.ok ? 'pass' : 'FAIL'} | ${spec.title} |`,
+  );
+  return [
+    '### Full-stack browser acceptance',
+    '',
+    `${String(report.stats.expected)} passed, ${String(report.stats.unexpected)} failed, ${String(report.stats.skipped)} skipped.`,
+    '',
+    '| Result | Test |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...rows,
+    '',
+    '#### Commit-to-render timings (task row `created_at` to visible card)',
+    '',
+    '```',
+    timings.trim(),
+    '```',
+  ].join('\n');
+}
+
+function main(): number {
+  const [reportPath, timingsPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
+  if (reportPath === undefined) {
+    console.error('usage: check-slice-report.ts <playwright-report.json> [timings.jsonl]');
+    return 2;
+  }
+  const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(reportPath, 'utf8')) as PlaywrightReport;
+  const timings = timingsPath === undefined ? '' : readFileSync(timingsPath, 'utf8');
+  console.log(summary(report, timings));
+  const found = problems(report);
+  for (const line of found) console.error(`slice report: ${line}`);
+  return found.length === 0 ? 0 : 1;
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1]?.endsWith('check-slice-report.ts') === true) process.exitCode = main();
